title: IT Manager-Operations( ERP Finsay)
description:
**Job Summary**
 To manage the company's complete IT operations and ensure smooth functioning of ERP, computer systems, network, CCTV and IT support services.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage and support ERP Finsys and resolve user queries/issues.
* Manage all office computers, laptops, printers and software.
* Maintain LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet and networking systems.
* Manage and troubleshoot CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR and recording systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support to all employees.
* Maintain IT assets, user IDs, access permissions and data backups.
* Coordinate with ERP, CCTV, hardware and other IT vendors.
* Ensure IT security, system availability and minimum downtime.
* Maintain proper records of IT complaints, assets, AMC and services.


 Qualification \& Experience
   

  

* Graduate/Diploma/BCA/B.Tech/MCA in IT or Computer Science.
* 5\-8 years of relevant IT experience.
* Experience in ERP, hardware, networking and CCTV preferred.


 Key Skills
   

  

 ERP Finsys \| IT Infrastructure \| Hardware \& Software \| Networking \| CCTV \| IT Support \| Data Backup \| Vendor Management \| IT Security
